overview: Finalize simulation coverage by implementing deterministic state compression for endgame snapshots and optimizing Monte Carlo convergence logic. This batch closes the last gaps in long-term stability and memory efficiency for the 5,500+ tick campaign.

tasks.title: Implement Zero-Heap Deterministic State Compressor
acceptance_criteria: Compress/Decompress round-trip is bit-exact for 5,500 ticks.
Zero dynamic memory allocations during compression.
Compression ratio > 40% for typical entity states.
tasks.player_fun_impact: Faster save/load times and reduced memory footprint for long campaigns.

tasks.title: Optimize Monte Carlo Convergence Check
acceptance_criteria: Convergence detected within 100 samples for stable systems.
Ring buffer implementation uses stack-only memory.
tasks.player_fun_impact: More accurate physics predictions and faster simulation steps.

tasks.title: Cache Last 10 Footstep Events for UI
acceptance_criteria: GetLast returns correct order (oldest to newest).
tasks.player_fun_impact: Instant access to recent activity log in UI.
